Tools are things you operate: calculators, simulators, converters, coding helpers, CAD systems, and other interactive technical applications.
:::

Technology Commons will collect course tools here as they are added.

## Planned tool groups

- design and measurement
- electronics and digital logic
- programming and data
- fabrication
- transportation and automotive work
- NICE project planning

The interactive NICE tool is planned after the core course shell is stable.
